expect: 真实产物可在目标环境按用户流程试运行
The real deliverable runs through the user flow in its target environment
ifWrong: 保留构建或安装错误，区分产物缺失与运行失败
Keep errors and distinguish missing output from runtime failure

expect: release.md记下版本、产物、结果和恢复方法
release.md records revision, output, results and recovery
ifWrong: 重新读取文档，补实际路径和未验证项
Reread it and add actual paths and pending checks

expect: 本人已确认本次账号、入口、版本与费用
The person approves this account, entry, version and costs
ifWrong: 缺确认或有阻断就停在准备状态
Stay in preparation if approval or readiness is missing

expect: 渠道状态明确区分已发布、待审核或失败
The channel distinguishes published, pending review and failed
ifWrong: 查看渠道实际状态，不凭上传成功宣布上线
Check channel status rather than treating upload as release

expect: 普通账号在实际入口完成检查并记录结果
An ordinary account checks the real entry and records results
ifWrong: 记录失败并执行已确认恢复方案，回反馈处理
Record failure, follow the agreed recovery plan and report it

expect: 项目满足纯静态条件，知道这是可选准备
The project qualifies as static and this is optional preparation
ifWrong: 需要服务端或密钥则回技术方案，不强用Pages
Revisit design if servers or secrets are needed

expect: 输出目录与资源路径来自真实构建配置
Output directory and asset paths come from actual build configuration
ifWrong: 要求读取配置核对，不根据目录名字猜测
Read configuration instead of guessing directories

expect: 配置说明已准备，下一步回产物试运行
Configuration notes are ready; return to deliverable trials
ifWrong: 不要现在创建远端或推送，回交付物节点
Do not create remotes or push here; return to packaging

expect: 维护表有负责人、频率、入口和异常处理
Maintenance has owners, frequency, entries and failure handling
ifWrong: 删掉不适用任务，为实际依赖补负责人
Remove irrelevant tasks and assign actual dependencies

expect: 测试恢复后的数据能读取且内容正确
Restored test data is readable and correct
ifWrong: 保留原始数据，检查备份范围和恢复步骤
Preserve originals and inspect backup coverage and recovery steps

expect: 检查实际用量及有效期，升级有回退版本
Usage and expiry are checked; upgrades have rollback versions
ifWrong: 先补测试与回退，不直接升级正式环境
Prepare testing and rollback before production upgrades

expect: 新需求更新相关文档，新对话能找到下一任务
Changes update related docs; a new chat can find the next task
ifWrong: 先读取交接记录，澄清变化后再继续开发
Read the handoff and clarify the change before development
